commit.subject: LU-10026 tests: drop redundant gate in sanity-compr/2002
commit.message:
LU-10026 tests: drop redundant gate in sanity-compr/2002

sanity-compr now checks compression support and enablement at
file scope, so test_2002 does not need its own skip gate.

This is the remaining delta of a later snapshot of the change
that introduced test_2002; the rest of it is already applied.

DDN-bug-id: EX-11120
Signed-off-by: Sergey Cheremencev <scherementsev@ddn.com>
